statement_name: LemmaE.1, An expected maximum under an envelope moment
headline_status: qualified_nonnegative_budget_statement_proved; forcedsource,10stricttransitiveaudits and independentreview passed; unchangednegative-real-budgetstatement unclaimed

qualification.reason: The printed statement does not constrain the real budget scaleA, but its right side is linear inA whileA^q can be positive at negativeA. The proof also requiresu=A*L^(-1/q)>0 onceA is nonzero.

counterexample.observations: AllYi are identically zero, withp=n=1, on any probability space. They are measurable, independent and centered with finite moments.

qualification.v_nonneg: No additionalv>=0 assumption is needed: the coordinate variance budgets imply it whenp>=1.
qualification.finite_moment_semantics: The formal contract includes integrability of each genuineq-envelope moment. The derived second-moment and norm-sum integrability prevent totalized Bochner integrals from making the assumptions vacuous.

passages.obligation: Expectedmaximum of actual independent centered observations under the printed q-envelope/variance budgets, with the necessary explicit qualificationA>=0 and a positiveCq preceding every model.

expanded_types.expanded_type: ∀ (q : ℝ), 2 < q → ∃ C, 0 < C ∧ RectangleCLTArxivV1.ExpectedMaximumEnvelopeBound q C

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {p n : ℕ} (Y : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  1 ≤ p →
    (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (Y i)) →
      ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun Y μ →
        (∀ (i : Fin n) (j : Fin p), ∫ (ω : Ω), Y i ω j ∂μ = 0) →
          ∀ {q A v : ℝ},
            2 < q →
              0 ≤ A →
                (∀ (i : Fin n), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => ‖Y i ω‖ ^ q) μ) →
                  ∑ i, ∫ (ω : Ω), ‖Y i ω‖ ^ q ∂μ ≤ A ^ q →
                    (∀ (j : Fin p), ∑ i, ∫ (ω : Ω), Y i ω j ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ v) →
                      ∫ (ω : Ω), ‖RectangleCLT.sumVector Y ω‖ ∂μ ≤
                        RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.envelopeMaximumConstant *
                          (√(v * RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p) + A * RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p ^ (1 - 1 / q))

passages.obligation: Interpret the displayed finite expectations by genuine integrability. Coordinate second integrability and norm-sum expectation finiteness follow from q>2; raw observations are not assumed bounded.

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {n : ℕ} (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), Measurable (X i)) →
    ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X μ →
      (∀ (i : Fin n), MeasureTheory.Integrable (X i) μ) →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => X i ω ^ 2) μ) →
          (∀ (i : Fin n), ∫ (ω : Ω), X i ω ∂μ = 0) →
            ∀ {b t v : ℝ},
              0 < b →
                |t| * b < 3 →
                  (∀ (i : Fin n), ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, |X i ω| ≤ b) →
                    ∑ i, ∫ (ω : Ω), X i ω ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ v →
                      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * ∑ i, X i ω)) μ ∧
                        ProbabilityTheory.mgf (fun ω => ∑ i, X i ω) μ t ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 * v / (2 * (1 - |t| * b / 3)))

∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {p n : ℕ} {T : Fin n → Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p} {u t v : ℝ},
  RectangleCLT.BoundedIndependentHypotheses μ T u →
    1 ≤ p →
      0 < u →
        0 < t →
          t * u < 3 →
            (∀ (j : Fin p), ∑ i, ∫ (ω : Ω), T i ω j ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ v) →
              MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * ‖RectangleCLT.sumVector T ω‖)) μ ∧
                ProbabilityTheory.mgf (fun ω => ‖RectangleCLT.sumVector T ω‖) μ t ≤
                  Real.exp (Real.log (2 * ↑p) + t ^ 2 * v / (2 * (1 - t * u / 3)))
